item.text: I’ll check Mistral’s current official documentation and identify the exact model names listed as supporting FIM.

Mistral’s current documentation lists **Codestral** as supporting FIM:

- `codestral-2508` — current Codestral model, via `/v1/fim/completions` ([model page](https://docs.mistral.ai/models/codestral-25-08))
- `codestral-2501` — supported FIM model, but retired ([model page](https://docs.mistral.ai/models/codestral-25-01))
- `codestral-2405` — supported FIM model, but retired ([model page](https://docs.mistral.ai/models/codestral-24-05))

For new integrations, use `codestral-latest` or the current Codestral model ID. The FIM endpoint documentation specifies that the `model` must be a model with FIM support ([FIM API documentation](https://docs.mistral.ai/api/endpoint/fim)).
